f59aee00a916248d7022042ff6cb62b68e94dd29.summary: Article on AlphV (aka BlackCat) publicly claiming an attack on Tipalti, an accounts-payable software firm, before contacting the victim or extorting it. AlphV says it has been present in Tipalti systems since September 2023 and has exfiltrated over 265GB of data. It plans to pressure Tipalti and clients including Roblox and Twitch. No proof was posted. Tipalti said it has not detected any data loss or breach of its systems.
